paragraphs: Mentioned in Shabbat, chapter 4, halakhah 1, reporting in the name of R' Yose son of R' Chanina. Hyman says it appears that it SHOULD READ R' Yehudah ben Pazi.[^1]

notes.text: פ״ד ה״א explicitly supplies chapter 4 halakhah 1, without an independently established Talmud corpus or edition. Hyman tentatively proposes Yehudah in place of the headed Yose; that proposal is not silently adopted. The second Yose and the father’s title remain fully represented, without merging the Yose occurrences. All four abbreviated personal titles remain R'.
